name: Tool Provenance Verification
description: Verifies tool registration, approval, version, and description integrity before every invocation.
threat_addressed: Tool descriptions modified after approval constitute a semantic supply chain attack. Agents following tampered descriptions may execute unintended operations.
enforcement_mechanism: Before every tool invocation — verify tool is registered, approved, version-matched, and description hash matches audited baseline. Mismatch triggers block and alert.

security_outcome.pass: Tool provenance verified — registered, approved, version and hash match.
security_outcome.fail: Unregistered tool, hash mismatch, or version mismatch detected.
